geometry_edits.rationale: Broaden the public notch to make the street-facing opening more legible at the ground plane.
Extend the access carve vertically so the threshold reads as a deliberate entry void rather than a minor subtraction.
Keep the carve anchored to the same western corner logic while enlarging its public effect.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent dominant stepped bar with a cut corner and lift, and it is legible across all four views. The silhouette is not merely a generic staircase; the stepped section has capacity-bearing continuity and a stable primary mass. The main weakness is that the public/ground void is only lightly articulated: the access edge is acknowledged, but the opening remains small relative to the mass and could become a more explicit court, notch, or undercut. Programmatically it is plausible for neighborhood living because the form supports compact upper hierarchy and an active mixed-use ground, but it still feels slightly over-compact and more object-like than spatially public at grade. The existing genotype is close; the best next move would be to strengthen the entry void and make the access edge more semantically clear without losing the dominant stepped gesture.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced bar mass with a clear carved public core and a legible sectional procession can support neighborhood-scale mixed use.
Interlocking rectilinear wings and elevated voids can create an active ground/courtyard relationship without overcomplicating the main mass.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Smaller and flatter than the candidate; use as a threshold/grounding reference, not for overall massing.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A compact low-rise volume with a simple canopy/entry notch reinforces street-level public threshold.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Counterfactual: much stronger continuous loop/ramp condition and more overt sectional drama than the candidate; do not copy the building form.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped section and terrace-ribbon logic can inform the candidate's sectional hierarchy.

warnings: Parcel containment was not deterministically assessable from the provided four-view preview alone; assuming the candidate is contained as required by the hard gate.
The access response is present but relatively muted; stronger public threshold articulation would better match the west-facing program access side.
No obvious view-to-view collision failure; silhouette continuity is consistent enough to pass.
